purpose: Transform Validator from a terminal rule checker into a quality mentor that explains failures, proposes safe repairs, and sends repair guidance upstream and downstream.

severityLevels.automatic: Grammar, punctuation, repetition, transition, formatting, headline wording, image relevance metadata; Publishing Editor repairs without full rewrite.
severityLevels.headline: Headline/body mismatch, word salad, source similarity, truncation; Headline Editor repairs only headline and resubmits.
severityLevels.evidence: Missing context, source disagreement, weak facts; send to Dossier/Evidence Engine, not Writer guessing.
severityLevels.fatal: Fabricated facts, contradictory unreconciled evidence, no reliable source, corrupted article identity; hold until evidence is fixed.

rule: Validator should block only unresolved publishability failures after the Publishing Editor has repaired every safe issue. Every block must include repair guidance and a prevention lesson.
